# get the land forcing files mkdir $work/FORCING set ys = 1948 set ye = 1977 set land_forcing_dir = /lustre/f2/dev//Sergey.Malyshev/DATA/land_forcing/Sheffield/2011-03-14 set year = $ys touch $work/file_table while ( $year <= $ye ) ls -1 $land_forcing_dir/$year.nc >> $work/file_table @ year ++ end
#form the file_table for the input atmospheric forcing #ls -1 $work/FORCING/*.nc > $work/file_table
# increase "ye" by 1 to prepare for using it in the prescr_forcing_nml end of loop @ ye ++
# get the land forcing files set ys = 0001 set ye = 0020 ls -1 /lustre/f2/pdata/gfdl/gfdl_sd/SPEAR_c384_OM4p25/land_forcing/*.land_forcing.tile1.nc > $work/file_table
